description: Left at the mention of the door, and brought the sops back.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Called the jaw a quince, priced the drawing at a shilling, and sent him upstairs to write.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Offered the Ghent door, and did not offer to be the friend who shuts it.
name: Gillis Verbeke

description: Gave the litany its response, and did not speak to him.
name: Sir John Spencer

description: Opened on St Michael, and told him the hand might stay.
name: Master Josias Thwaite
